parameters.jsCode:
const body = $input.first().json.body;
return [{ json: {
  candidat_nom:         body.candidat_nom,
  candidat_email:       body.candidat_email,
  candidat_telephone:   body.candidat_telephone || '',
  offre_id:             body.offre_id,
  titre_poste:          body.titre_poste,
  description_poste:    body.description_poste || '',
  competences_requises: body.competences_requises || '',
  annees_experience:    body.annees_experience || '',
  langues_requises:     body.langues_requises || '',
  exigences_ia:         body.exigences_ia || '',
  type_contrat:         body.type_contrat || '',
  localisation:         body.localisation || '',
  email_recruteur:      body.email_recruteur,
  cv_base64:            body.cv_base64 || '',
  cv_mimetype:          body.cv_mimetype || 'application/pdf',
  lettre_base64:        body.lettre_base64 || '',
  lettre_mimetype:      body.lettre_mimetype || 'application/pdf',
  date_candidature:     body.date_candidature || new Date().toISOString(),
  candidature_id:       body.candidature_id || '',
  callback_url:         body.callback_url || '',
  test_requis:          body.test_requis === true || body.test_requis === 'true',
  automatisation_active:body.automatisation_active === true || body.automatisation_active === 'true',
  lien_calendar:        body.lien_calendar || '',
  callback_secret:      body.callback_secret || '',
  company:              body.company || 'solumada',
  formule_remerciement: body.formule_remerciement || ''
}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ score: $json.score, recommandation: $json.recommandation, resume_analyse: $json.resume_analyse, adequation_poste: $json.adequation_poste, competences_detectees: $json.competences_detectees, competences_manquantes: $json.competences_manquantes, experience_annees: $json.experience_annees, niveau_education: $json.niveau_education, points_forts: $json.points_forts, points_faibles: $json.points_faibles }) }}

parameters.url: ={{ $('05 - Parse Claude Response').item.json.callback_url + '/' + $('05 - Parse Claude Response').item.json.candidature_id + '/no-rdv' }}

body.description_poste:
- Annotate image and video datasets (bounding boxes, segmentation, keypoints) for Computer Vision model training.
- Strictly apply client annotation guidelines.
- Participate in inter-annotator calibration sessions.
- Identify and escalate ambiguities or errors in guidelines.
- Meet productivity and quality KPIs (IAA ≥ 95%).
body.competences_requises:
- **Bac+2 minimum** (all fields; science or IT preferred).
- Proficiency in at least one annotation tool (CVAT, Labelbox, Label Studio, V7) — an asset.
- Basic knowledge of AI/Machine Learning — a plus.
- Good typing speed and precision.
body.exigences_ia:
- prior experience in data annotation OR structured data entry.
 - proficiency in an annotation tool (CVAT, Labelbox, etc.).
-  confirmed French level B2+.
-  knowledge of Machine Learning / Computer Vision.
-  English B1+ for reading guidelines.
